description: Bounded cache store fails to invoke eviction listeners on explicit removal and clear, leaking session handles in memory.
spec_notes: BoundedCache must guarantee all eviction listeners fire whenever items leave the cache.

tests.test_memory_leak.py:
from session_pool import SessionPool


def test_automatic_eviction_unregisters_handle():
    pool = SessionPool(capacity=2)
    pool.acquire_session("s1", {"user": "alice"})
    pool.acquire_session("s2", {"user": "bob"})
    assert pool.tracker.live_count == 2

    # Acquiring 3rd session triggers eviction of s1
    pool.acquire_session("s3", {"user": "charlie"})
    assert pool.tracker.live_count == 2
    assert "s1" not in pool.tracker.active_handles
    assert "s2" in pool.tracker.active_handles
    assert "s3" in pool.tracker.active_handles


def test_explicit_terminate_cleans_up_handle():
    pool = SessionPool(capacity=3)
    pool.acquire_session("sess_x", {"token": "abc"})
    pool.acquire_session("sess_y", {"token": "def"})
    assert pool.tracker.live_count == 2

    # Explicit termination must release memory handle
    res = pool.terminate_session("sess_x")
    assert res is True
    assert pool.tracker.live_count == 1
    assert "sess_x" not in pool.tracker.active_handles


def test_close_all_releases_all_dangling_sessions():
    pool = SessionPool(capacity=5)
    for i in range(4):
        pool.acquire_session(f"s_{i}", {"idx": i})
    assert pool.tracker.live_count == 4

    pool.close_all()
    assert pool.tracker.live_count == 0
    assert len(pool.tracker.active_handles) == 0


def test_access_existing_key_promotes_without_leaking():
    pool = SessionPool(capacity=2)
    pool.acquire_session("k1", {"count": 1})
    pool.acquire_session("k2", {"count": 1})
    pool.acquire_session("k1", {"count": 2})  # Update k1
    assert pool.tracker.live_count == 2

    pool.acquire_session("k3", {"count": 1})  # Evicts oldest (k2, since k1 was accessed)
    assert "k2" not in pool.tracker.active_handles
    assert "k1" in pool.tracker.active_handles
    assert "k3" in pool.tracker.active_handles


def test_terminate_nonexistent_returns_false_safely():
    pool = SessionPool(capacity=2)
    assert pool.terminate_session("ghost") is False
    assert pool.tracker.live_count == 0
